interpretation.encoder: Native encoder not supported as an overall improvement by matched3000-step pair. Preserve negative result.
interpretation.guard: Native guard2 reduces identity MAE by about49.17%, removes observed near-clean source damage and improves compression mean; SR/deblur/denoise PSNR and LPIPS regress against native guard0.5. This is a conservative tradeoff, not a uniformly better restorer. Independent review also finds near-clean LPIPS and flow-aligned error worsen: .003460 to .004206, and .002602 to .002896. MSE protection alone is insufficient to promote guard2.
interpretation.confidence: Frozen fidelity SHA and all reported RGB/control/temporal scores exactly agree with parent. Ordinary-task1sigma coverage81.46–95.54% differs from Gaussian68.27%; no independently calibrated action-risk or confidence-driven quality improvement claim.
interpretation.temporal: Stride4 flow-aligned screening is not stride1 flicker or long-video validation.
interpretation.controls: Identity residual remains nonzero on8/8 sources, though small; near-clean0/8 damage is this development sample and threshold only.
interpretation.interaction: No legacy_g20 arm; encoder-by-guard interaction is not identified.

integration_candidate.purpose: Frozen reference for a fixed-H3 engineering diagnostic, not an accepted omni model
integration_candidate.rationale: Native encoder has no demonstrated overall gain; guard2 sacrifices SR/deblur/denoise and near-clean perceptual/temporal quality. Retain the stronger original final-step reference; preserve compression and near-clean failure cases.
integration_candidate.full_h3_launch_gate: One deterministic source, all four tasks, stride1; inspect actual H3/VAE smoke and exact pair contract before extending.

candidate_review_history.reason: Preliminary conservative engineering choice considered MSE protection; source-paired LPIPS and temporal review shows clear degradation. Prepared queue was never launched.
